title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-20
lineage: SBD > MR > ? > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A jumbled matrix recording with spotty sound quality, but a decent Cold Rain & Snow and solid Good Lovin' performance.
ai_review.review: The tape is an odd mixture of sound‑board (SBD) and audience (AUD) sources from two different dates (3/20/70 and 11/11/70), which makes the set order confusing and the audio inconsistent – the opening tracks are muddy while later sections are clearer. Musically the only clear high point is a strong Cold Rain & Snow with a nice Jerry solo, and Good Lovin' sounds fine; otherwise the show offers no standout moments to outweigh the technical mess.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple reviewers note serious recording problems and a confusing track order, but a few highlight decent musical spots; the weighted average of star scores (≈2.2) and the mixed commentary lead to a low‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tracks switch between SBD (soundboard) and AUD (audience) sources, causing inconsistent clarity – early tracks are described as “bad sound” or “muddy,” later electric sections are noted as “fine.” The tape is jumbled, with duplicate filler from another show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Confusing; the recording stitches together parts of two different concerts (3‑20‑70 and 11‑11‑70), resulting in a disjointed set order that makes following the show difficult.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice solo on Cold Rain & Snow noted by reviewers.
